features.title: Live twin
features.description: The live dashboard: the simulated facility's current readings, cooling mode and alerts as they stream in.

features.title: Alerts centre
features.description: Anomaly alerts with an incident workflow: status, assignee and notes, an audit trail, and an explanation of why each alert fired.

features.title: What-if lab
features.description: Runs the simulator under changed load, ambient temperature, set-point or cooling mode and shows the differences, with a one-at-a-time sensitivity sweep.

features.title: Optimizer
features.description: A rule-based baseline recommendation and a sandbox, and stored proposals that an admin approves or rejects. Nothing is sent to equipment.

features.title: Fleet view
features.description: Ranks five simulated sites, which are parameter sets of the same simulator, by PUE, carbon and rule-checked alert conditions.

features.title: Capacity
features.description: Capacity headroom of the simulated facility.

features.title: Maintenance
features.description: Equipment health and maintenance work orders.

features.title: Evaluation reports
features.description: Stored policy evaluation reports and their registered decisions.

features.title: Telemetry history
features.description: Stored telemetry samples of a sensor over a time range, and the gaps in them.

features.title: Runs
features.description: Recorded simulation and training runs and their results.

features.title: Report
features.description: A printable report page with a simulated-data banner.

features.title: Admin console
features.description: User roles, the audit log and webhooks. Admin only.
